learning_objective: 🎯 We will discover the wonderful animals and birds that live around us and the plants they need to survive!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Animals live everywhere! Fishes live in the cool water, monkeys swing on tall trees, and cows live on the green land with us.
Just like us, animals get hungry too. Some animals munch on fresh green grass and leaves, while birds love eating small seeds and sweet fruits!
Animals and birds are our silent friends. We should never hurt them. We can leave a small bowl of water outside for birds on a hot sunny day!

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Make an Animal Mask!
fun_activity.instructions: Use a paper plate to draw the face of a lion, monkey, or rabbit. Cut out holes for eyes, color it, and act like your favorite animal!

quick_recap: ⭐ Animals and birds live all around us on land, in water, and on trees.
⭐ Different animals eat different things like grass, leaves, and seeds.
⭐ We must always be kind, gentle, and caring towards all animals.
